steady_state.note: frames in RAM(궤적 0~2), window LRU bypass

pos_check.what: atan2(y',x') of true_ego_pos in RSU-local vs derived/aod phi_t (dominant path AoD)

lidar_pool8.pool: AdaptiveAvgPool2d((8,8)) on [384,100,176] (100/8·176/8 비정수 → torch adaptive bin)
lidar_pool8.layout: [Nf, cell=row*8+col (row=y 배열프레임·CARLA y 반전, col=x), 384ch] fp16

source_meta.frame_axes: row=y(array frame, CARLA y 반전), col=x

radar_raster64.layout: [Nf, ch(0=count,1=mean velocity m/s), range bin(0..120 m), azimuth bin(−fov/2..+fov/2, CARLA 부호 그대로)] fp16
